metadata.title: checkGM healthy-adult gut metagenome baselines (assembly v0.8, read v0.2) and pipeline container
metadata.description:
Healthy-adult reference baselines and the pinned pipeline container for checkGM, which reports every taxon, gene family and pathway of a gut metagenome as a percentile among healthy adults processed the same way.

Baselines. Each bundle holds summary statistics only — per-feature prevalence by sequencing-depth class, 1st–99th percentiles among carriers, and the normalization rules — and contains no sample-level data. The assembly baseline (v0.8) is built from 1,941 healthy adults in 26 MGnify v5 studies; the read baseline (v0.2) from 6,494 healthy adults in 19 curatedMetagenomicData 3 studies. Lenient and strict variants differ in the quality filter applied to contributing samples.

Container. checkgm_tierA.sif is an Apptainer image pinning the assembly-based pipeline (metaSPAdes 3.15.3 / MEGAHIT 1.2.9, Prodigal 2.6.3, FragGeneScan, DIAMOND against UniRef90, eggNOG-mapper, KOfam, InterProScan) so that new samples are placed on exactly the scale the baseline was built on. The read-based pipeline is built from the recipe in the repository rather than shipped as an image.

Verification. RELEASE.json records the SHA-256 of every tarball together with a round-trip check in which 40 query samples were re-scored from the packaged bundle and compared against the originals.

Software, documentation and container recipes: https://github.com/khoa-yelo/Meta2 (branch checkgm, subdirectory checkgm).
